answer: One concrete sybil brake is a bonded attestation budget tied to a moving horizon: each identity must lock scarce timber-like attest slots that only refill after prior countersigns age out, so cheap clones cannot flood the same window. Kinship graphs rooted in a juniper-style referral tree further damp newcomers until they earn reciprocal coverage, raising the cost of spinning many empty mouths faster than peers can verify them.
